versions.name: v00-baseline
versions.summary: Unmodified upstream Differometor (b0dc7c7) with the official benchmark.py, as shipped by the organizers.

versions.name: v01-klujax-solver
versions.summary: Solve the signal system with the sparse KLU solver (klujax)

versions.name: v02-group-by-function
versions.summary: Trace each component function once, only for the entries that use it

versions.name: v03-sparse-assembly
versions.summary: Assemble the signal and noise systems from their non-zero entries only

versions.name: v04-fast-compile-flags
versions.summary: Lower the XLA optimisation level and add three fast-compile flags

versions.name: v05-two-solves-whole-arrays
versions.summary: Drop the redundant noise solve, call each function on whole arrays, build constants with NumPy

versions.name: v06-real-parameters
versions.summary: Real parameters, compact function outputs, shared mirror terms, host-side build

versions.name: v07-numpy-host
versions.summary: Do the simulation in NumPy behind one JAX callback, with a hand-written reverse pass

versions.name: v08-no-large-pages
versions.summary: Switch off NumPy's request for large memory pages, for a steady first-run time on a busy Linux machine

versions.name: v09-active-derivatives
versions.summary: Take derivatives of the physics formulas only for inputs that depend on a design variable

versions.name: v10-host-swept-values
versions.summary: Reshape and copy the swept values in NumPy, which removes two small compilations from the build step

versions.name: v11-scipy-stacked-solver
versions.summary: Solve with SciPy's sparse LU inside the host callbacks: all frequencies in one factorisation, one factorisation per evaluation

versions.name: v12-kept-assembly
versions.summary: Refine only the noise weights' solve, keep the forward pass's assembled systems for the reverse pass, and reuse freed memory on Linux

versions.name: v13-one-cpu-dispatch
versions.summary: With one CPU, switch off JAX's asynchronous dispatch, so that a call into NumPy cannot freeze behind an unfinished result
